    Natural Fubini isomorphism for residual orbit push-down #

    For a normal subgroup N ◁ G, the iterated N- and G / N-indexed push-down value is linearly equivalent to the direct G-indexed push-down value. The equivalence uses the canonical quotient representative and the coherent addition isomorphism for deck shifts. Its compatibility with homogeneous orbit arrows extends linearly to a natural isomorphism of module functors.
